item.description:

item.title: Pothole by water leak, 20th August
item.description:
There is a bad water leak in the road near the bottom of York Hill outside number 30, it has caused a pot hole to form by the speed bump and is a safety issue - already someone has come off their bike. The water leak has been reported to Thames Water but as it is not sewerage it has not been prioritised. It is generating a lot of water that is spilling down York Hill to the junction with Norwood Road. Sorry I don't have a photo.
